viewCommand: Preview a file in the file viewer
empty: Click a file in an agent message, or use /view <path>.
notAFile: This path is not a regular file
tooLarge: This file is too large to preview
unreadable: The file could not be read
binary: No preview is available for this file type.
truncated: Showing the first {{size}}. The file is larger.
pdfUnavailable: PDF preview is available in the desktop and web apps.
htmlUnavailable: HTML preview is available in the desktop and web apps. Showing the source.
missingPath: Give a file path, for example /view docs/report.md

settings.linkMessages: Link file paths in agent replies
settings.linkMessagesHint: Paths to existing files become links, and a file bar appears under the reply.
settings.openInHint: Beside the chat keeps the conversation visible.
settings.detectBarePaths: Also find paths written without a link
settings.detectBarePathsHint: Covers older chats and replies that did not follow the link format.
settings.instructAgentsHint: Adds one line to agents when a session opens: write files as Markdown links to absolute paths. Applies to existing agents the next time they reopen.

videoUnavailable: Video playback is available in the desktop and web apps.
nativeAudioHint: Plays from the start. Seeking is available in the desktop and web apps.
